mapper.select: SELECT to_regclass('pf.checkpoint') IS NOT NULL AND to_regclass('pf.conversation_lease') IS NOT NULL AND to_regclass('pf.failure_record') IS NOT NULL AND to_regclass('pf.user_model_credential') IS NOT NULL AND to_regclass('pf.user_preference_revision') IS NOT NULL AND to_regclass('pf.task') IS NOT NULL AND to_regclass('pf.event_outbox') IS NOT NULL AND to_regclass('pf.acceptance_model_meter') IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT schema_version=1 FROM pf.baseline_version WHERE id=1) AS __column1
SELECT round_json AS __column1 FROM pf.model_turn WHERE task_id=#{slotTask,jdbcType=OTHER} AND status='COMMITTED' ORDER BY committed_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.tool_operation SET status='UNKNOWN',ended_at=now() WHERE task_id=#{slotTask,jdbcType=OTHER} AND status='RUNNING'
mapper.select: SELECT attempt_id AS __column1 FROM pf.checkpoint WHERE id=#{id,jdbcType=OTHER}
SELECT * FROM pf.checkpoint WHERE id=#{id,jdbcType=OTHER} AND space_id=#{spaceId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND task_id=#{taskId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND status='COMMITTED'
SELECT result_json AS __column1 FROM pf.tool_operation WHERE turn_id=#{turnId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND status='SUCCEEDED' ORDER BY created_at,id
SELECT id AS __column1, input_json AS __column2, round_json AS __column3 FROM pf.model_turn WHERE task_id=#{taskId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND status='COMMITTED' ORDER BY committed_at,id
SELECT call_json AS __column1, status AS __column2, result_json AS __column3 FROM pf.tool_operation WHERE task_id=#{taskId,jdbcType=OTHER} ORDER BY created_at,id

SELECT id AS __column1, round_json AS __column2, ordinal, content_hash AS __column4, input_json AS __column5, input_hash AS __column6 FROM pf.model_turn WHERE task_id=#{taskId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND status='COMMITTED' ORDER BY committed_at,id

SELECT state_key AS __column1 FROM pf_runtime.state_slot WHERE space_id=#{spaceId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND user_id=#{userId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND conversation_id=#{conversationId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND starts_with(state_key,#{prefix,jdbcType=OTHER})

UPDATE pf_runtime.state_slot SET payload_json=#{payload,jdbcType=OTHER}::jsonb,version=version+1,updated_at=now() WHERE space_id=#{spaceId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND user_id=#{userId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND conversation_id=#{conversationId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND state_key=#{stateKey,jdbcType=OTHER} AND version=#{version,jdbcType=OTHER} AND framework_version='2.0.4' RETURNING version AS __column1

INSERT INTO pf_runtime.state_slot(space_id,user_id,conversation_id,state_key,version,framework_version,payload_json) VALUES(#{spaceId,jdbcType=OTHER},#{userId,jdbcType=OTHER},#{conversationId,jdbcType=OTHER},#{stateKey,jdbcType=OTHER},1,'2.0.4',#{payload,jdbcType=OTHER}::jsonb) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING version AS __column1

SELECT version AS __column1, payload_json::text AS __column2, framework_version AS __column3 FROM pf_runtime.state_slot WHERE space_id=#{spaceId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND user_id=#{userId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND conversation_id=#{conversationId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND state_key=#{stateKey,jdbcType=OTHER}

SELECT status AS __column1, result_hash AS __column2 FROM pf.tool_operation WHERE space_id=#{spaceId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND task_id=#{taskId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND attempt_id=#{attemptId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND fencing_token=#{fence,jdbcType=OTHER} AND call_id=#{id,jdbcType=OTHER} AND call_hash=#{contentHash,jdbcType=OTHER} FOR UPDATE

SELECT status AS __column1, content_hash AS __column2, ordinal AS __column3, accepted_call_id AS __column4 FROM pf.model_turn WHERE id=#{id,jdbcType=OTHER} AND space_id=#{spaceId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND task_id=#{taskId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND attempt_id=#{attemptId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND fencing_token=#{fence,jdbcType=OTHER} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id AS __column1 FROM pf.model_turn WHERE attempt_id=#{attemptId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND status='OPEN'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pf.model_turn(id,space_id,task_id,attempt_id,fencing_token,ordinal,input_json,input_hash) SELECT #{id,jdbcType=OTHER},#{spaceId,jdbcType=OTHER},#{taskId,jdbcType=OTHER},#{attemptId,jdbcType=OTHER},#{fence,jdbcType=OTHER},coalesce(max(ordinal),0)+1,#{input,jdbcType=OTHER}::jsonb,#{contentHash,jdbcType=OTHER} FROM pf.model_turn WHERE attempt_id=#{attemptId2,jdbcType=OTHER}
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.tool_operation SET status='RUNNING' WHERE space_id=#{spaceId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND task_id=#{taskId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND attempt_id=#{attemptId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND fencing_token=#{fence,jdbcType=OTHER} AND call_id=#{id,jdbcType=OTHER} AND call_hash=#{contentHash,jdbcType=OTHER} AND status='PREPARED'

UPDATE pf.tool_operation SET status='SUCCEEDED',result_json=#{body,jdbcType=OTHER}::jsonb,result_hash=#{digest,jdbcType=OTHER},ended_at=now() WHERE task_id=#{taskId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND call_id=#{id,jdbcType=OTHER}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM pf_runtime.state_slot WHERE space_id=#{spaceId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND user_id=#{userId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND conversation_id=#{conversationId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND state_key=#{stateKey,jdbcType=OTHER}
